Demo details

Data is illustrative and stored in this local gallery. Seed initializes only an empty gallery; existing projects and tasks are preserved.

About this gallery

Clanker UI components are assembled at build time from a locked local package. Native admits read-only query forms and routes; app-owned commands create and edit the real sample records. Explore the 14-layout atlas and 31 component entries.
